profile.headline: New Year New Opportunities :-)
profile.geoLocationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
profile.summary:
My name is Delroy and I have been involved with web development for more than 15+ years, at least 10 of which I have been working full time, for various companies. 

My experience focuses on web projects with a strong focus on front-end and PHP, along with the modern frameworks. I also have a great level of understanding of Laravel and have released a couple of proprietary applications. 

Apart from that I also have several websites, and e-commerce projects under my belt and many custom complex server-side implementations supporting mobile applications which are collaborations done with other developers for various clients.

I’m a solid problem solver and have a great commitment to promised deadlines. I have always worked well in collaborate with multiple developers and other functional parties like designers etc.

Despite my overall preference for front-end development, I’m very confident in my back-end skills and would gladly handle tasks that imply such competence.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: Port St Lucie, Florida, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

    Led Development and Migration: Designed, integrated, and migrated web pages and sites, ensuring seamless backend integration and transitioning legacy applications to web compatibility.
    Utilized Advanced Tools: Employed a diverse suite of web development technologies, including Python, Flask, PHP, HTML5, CSS, Vue.js, React, JavaScript, JQuery, SQLAlchemy, and WordPress.
    Focused on E-Commerce Solutions: Regularly engaged with E-Commerce and web application technologies, prioritizing the delivery of performant, reliable, and maintainable code.
    Integrated Applications: Managed the integration of applications into the company's tech infrastructure and business processes.
    Mentorship and Team Development: Provided technical and functional mentorship to team members, fostering expertise in key areas.
    Collaborated with Business Leadership: Maintained continuous collaboration with the Business Owner to ensure technical solutions aligned with company objectives.
    Managed Full Development Lifecycle: Led the full system development lifecycle, from analysis and design to maintenance, ensuring reliability and efficiency at every phase.
    Optimized Cloud Environments: Supervised the maintenance and optimization of AWS and OpenShift environments.
    Developed Administrative Panels: Created administrative panels using Python to enhance business operations.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Design and implementation of the overall web architecture
“Pixel-perfect” implementation of our approved user interface
Design and deployment of our database
Ensuring the entire stack is designed and built for speed, low cost, and scalability
Design and construction of our REST API
Integrating our front-end UI with the constructed API
Design and implementation of continuous integration and deployment
Maintaining Python code base and bug fixes where necessary 

Writing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Being up to date on latest practices is a must, e.g., HTML5, CSS3, and ECMAScript 6

Working with NodeJS
Working with RedShift
Working with Docker
Database design and management, including being up to date on the latest practices of Dynamodb and other Cloud-based database technologies
Working with erverless technologies such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch, CloudFront, S3
Designing and building serverless applications

Implementing Vue Framework and common UI libraries
Implementing CSS preprocessors, bundlers, and associated languages such as Sass and Webpack
Implementing testing platforms and unit tests
Proficiency with Git
Always writing  clean and well documented code
